primary_scope: Rosenthal punctuation §§47–63, with §§52–54 and covered/editorial branches treated according to files 243/244
current_norm_gate: Full Academic Guide under V. V. Lopatin §§133–152 plus current orthographic §§192, 195, 197 and brand/name rules where quotation-mark use intersects official naming
normalization_rule: Direct-speech schemes are counted by structural decision engines, not by each punctuation symbol. Citation/quotation systems own their formatting decision while capitalization remains owned by the orthographic capitalization families from Wave A.

P24_direct_speech_base.canonical_label: Прямая речь: базовый способ оформления в строку или с абзаца
branches: inline direct speech in quotation marks
paragraph direct speech introduced by dash without quotation marks
combined nesting when one person's direct speech includes another person's quoted speech
P24_direct_speech_base.ownership_boundary: Detailed author-word placement belongs to sibling engines below; dialogue replica details remain owned by school-dialogue-replica-punctuation.

P25_P26_adjacent_author_words.canonical_label: Прямая речь и соседние слова автора: слова автора до или после прямой речи
P25_P26_adjacent_author_words.current_norm: Lopatin §134 treats both orientations in one rule system
branches: author words before direct speech: colon before the quoted direct speech, capitalization and terminal signs by the direct-speech structure
direct speech before author words: comma+dash after declarative direct speech or preservation of ? ! … followed by dash; author words begin lowercase in the ordinary continuation pattern
P25_P26_adjacent_author_words.counting_policy: One relative-position decision with two mirror branches. Do not count 'author before' and 'author after' as two denominator identities.

covered_section_50_reconsolidation.canonical_label: Слова автора разрывают прямую речь: знак в месте разрыва и продолжение второй части
branches: break at no sign/comma point
break at period/sentence boundary
break after question/exclamation/ellipsis
author words themselves split into two semantic parts where current §135 requires a different continuation scheme
covered_section_50_reconsolidation.reason: The three historical Grade-8 records are route/practice branches of one source/current decision engine. Their differing punctuation is the output branch, not three independent mastery identities.

branches: colon and opening quotation before the inserted direct speech
comma after closing quotation when required by the interrupted author sentence
dash after closing quotation when no comma is structurally required at the interruption point
terminal ? ! … interactions according to the current rule

covered_dialogue.reason: Dialogue/replica formatting is a distinct conversational layout decision and is already current-source owned; no new count.

editorial_direct_speech_blocks.reason: Editorial/dramatic layout details do not establish additional deterministic school mastery identities beyond the active direct-speech/dialogue engines.

P28_citations.canonical_label: Цитата в авторском тексте: кавычки, многоточие, прописная/строчная и ссылка на источник
branches: citation as independent quotation vs syntactically embedded fragment
quotation marks or block/verse formatting without quotation marks
ellipsis for omitted beginning/middle/end while preserving citation structure
capital/lowercase at citation start by syntactic integration and source text
author/source reference punctuation
citation nested inside direct speech or another quotation
P28_citations.counting_policy: One citation-formatting decision engine with structured branches, not four denominator identities for four source paragraphs.

P29_quotation_marks.canonical_label: Кавычки: чужое/условное слово и официальное название — ставить или не ставить
current_norm: Lopatin orthographic §§192, 195, 197 and current trademark/product/variety name rules for official names
branches: unusual, conventional, ironic or alien word in author's text
title of literary/scientific/artistic/media work when current name structure requires quotation marks
organization/business/venue/product name with a nonsyntactically integrated proper designation
awards/orders/medals: quotation marks only for the current structural class, not mechanically for every award name
trademarks/product models/varieties/breeds under current official-name conventions
lexicalized generic use or an official name class that current norm writes without quotation marks
P29_quotation_marks.ownership_boundary: This unit owns quotation-mark presence. Capitalization inside the name remains owned by Wave-A capitalization families; direct-speech and citation quotation marks remain owned by P24/P28.
